subject: WiFi intermittent drops affecting POS and ordering systems
description: The WiFi network at ServeWell - Adyar has been experiencing intermittent disconnections throughout the day, particularly during peak hours between 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM. Point-of-sale terminals lose connectivity for 30-60 seconds at a time, disrupting order processing and payment transactions. Staff have reported the issue starting approximately 3 days ago. The NetLink NL-3000 router appears to be functioning normally based on LED indicators, but devices are unable to maintain stable connections.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and logged. Initial assessment: customer advised to check router placement and verify no physical obstructions. Escalation to L2 network team recommended if issue persists.
